data.name: Dave
data.long_meaning: The name Dave is derived from the English word ‘dave’, which comes from the Old English word ‘dæfa’, meaning ‘beloved’ or ‘dear’. In the Middle Ages, it was a nickname for someone who was ‘beloved’ or ‘dear’. Today, Dave is a popular name for boys and is often used interchangeably with ‘David’, which has a similar meaning and biblical connection.
